Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture sheet, NOT a concept rendering. Create a new square 2x2 atlas of FOUR EQUAL SQUARE surface panels with exact dividing lines x=.5 and y=.5, no gaps, labels or background. The input nav atlas is ONLY a faction insignia/paint reference, not an edit target. This is textured military machinery, not stone, rusty noise or flat recolored camouflage. Neutral flat diffuse/albedo, orthographic full bleed, no perspective, shadows, bloom or rendered object. Crisp readable mechanical construction, broad quiet manufactured paint surfaces, restrained small scratches localized to edges, bolts and panel seams; not evenly scattered grunge. Each cell must have its meaningful markings inside its inner 60%, outside edges quiet matching base metal; no outer frame, no tile-like rim, no letters or numbers.
CELL TOP LEFT: ammo service hatch, faction-painted armored metal, single SMALL faction insignia exactly at center, surrounded by clean mechanical panel joints, small rivets, cobalt-blue narrow identity band and three tiny cyan status slots below it. Insignia entirely within radius .22 of the cell center. Leave relief shallow, not a separate crate.
CELL TOP RIGHT: AMMO SIDE CASING, no emblem: engineered graphite recessed vertical cooling fins in middle half, faction-colored casing steel outside, two slim COBALT BLUE vertical ceramic strips at local x=.3 and .7, tiny mechanical latch at bottom. Strong blue ammo read but no big diagonal stripe wall; no letters. Symmetrical mechanical construction, not an illustrated vent in perspective. This repeats on differently shaped faces so NO painted logo, NO outside border, NO centered badge.
CELL BOTTOM LEFT: REPAIR SERVICE HATCH, warm ivory enamel and graphite service plate, single small faction insignia centered, emerald-green narrow trim and small green repair-tool pictogram below. Clean military maintenance equipment, not human first aid. Insignia within radius .22 of center, no border touching edges.
CELL BOTTOM RIGHT: REPAIR SIDE CASING, no emblem: warm ivory enameled hard-surface shell, graphite inset rectangular mechanical recess with horizontal service ribs through central half, two slender emerald-green vertical maintenance rails at local x=.30 and .70, four tiny fasteners and a narrow green equipment stripe. The white/graphite/green contrast must remain clear; not an all-green blob. Clean, functional equipment with restrained faction paint accents. No diagonal hazard stripes and NO large cross or logo on utility panel.
NSDF identity: muted olive-brown faction paint, off-white accents and one regular geometrically balanced white five-point US military star, equal arms and one tip straight up. Ammo olive/blue/graphite; repair ivory/olive/green.
